notes_for_editor: Only Wikipedia's Louisiana list gives this tower any detail, and it gives nothing on construction, height, ownership, staffing or use. The list's note that it looks disused or retired sits beside a note that it is visible on Google Street View; neither is a dated record. Two web searches returned no tower history. The local NHLR crawl has no page for this tower (nhlr.org/lookouts/us/la/lorraine-lookout-tower/ returns 404), and the FFLA Louisiana cache does not name it. A Fire Tower Rd in Ponchatoula (Redfin address listing) is not linked to this tower and is not used. Worth asking the LDAF Office of Forestry or the Louisiana chapter of FFLA for records, and a photo would be the main gain. The story is short by design; do not pad it.
